# Push by Techulus

Push by Techulus offers a cross-platform solution for sending push notifications via code and no-code to deliver transactional information in real-time.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/push-by-techulus/.

## Actions

- **Delete Team Member or Invite**: Remove a user from the team or revoke a pending invitation.
- **Invite User to Team**: Invite a user to a team by sending an email invitation.
- **Send Notification Sync**: Send push notifications synchronously to all linked devices.
- **Send Notification to Device Group**: Send push notification to a specific device group.
- **Send Notification via Webhook POST**: Send push notifications to all devices associated with a specific API key via POST request.
- **Send Push Notification Async**: Send push notification asynchronously to all devices in an account or team.
